pathIdentity.result: Each constructed variant refuses before worktree creation without branch or registration residue. Existing mode-000 directories refuse; canonical whitespace-ending directories pass the identity guards. A Git-registered variant yields one named beacon refusal while a healthy row and group cache remain readable. On a second registered worktree, a mode-000 beacon directory, a searchable but unlistable one and a sealed parent each yield that row's refusal with its directory and reason while the healthy row is swept; single-root guards refuse naming the directory.

repair.rule: Complete predicate units preserve auxiliary chains, tense/aspect, modifiers, status reason phrases, presentation and local polarity before clause segmentation. An anchored unknown modifier cannot silently discard a recognized failure. Requirement voice, healthy negation and counted quantities remain controls.
repair.controls: The independent 3564 supplied-class matrix covers both selection and host checking. Both operator and resident entries execute failure assertions in both supplied classes. Advancing-clock fixtures assert original source identities, reproduction or a durable finding, zero later worker/push/PR effects on findings, and nine healthy requirements completing all fourteen steps.
